name: 20759 · Fulton, MD
findings: ZIP 20759 (Fulton) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20759 (Fulton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20759 (Fulton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
